text: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE. Left breast segmental mastectomy with sentinel lymph node biopsy. Final diagnosis: invasive ductal carcinoma of the breast, 2.1 cm, grade 2. Margins negative. Two sentinel lymph nodes negative for carcinoma. No evidence of metastatic disease.

SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE. Right breast lumpectomy specimen. Diagnosis: invasive ductal carcinoma, 1.4 cm. Sentinel lymph node biopsy negative. Estrogen receptor positive. Margins free of carcinoma. No metastasis identified.

SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE. Modified radical mastectomy, left breast. Invasive lobular carcinoma of the breast, 3.0 cm. Three of twelve axillary lymph nodes positive for metastatic carcinoma. Axillary nodal metastasis present.

SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE. Right upper lobe lobectomy. Diagnosis: lung adenocarcinoma, 2.8 cm, acinar predominant. Visceral pleura not involved. Hilar lymph nodes negative. No metastatic disease identified in sampled nodes.
SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE. Left lower lobe wedge resection of the lung. Adenocarcinoma of the lung, 1.9 cm, lepidic pattern. Margins negative. Peribronchial lymph nodes free of tumor. No metastasis.
SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE. Right pneumonectomy. Lung adenocarcinoma, 4.2 cm, with two mediastinal lymph nodes positive for metastatic adenocarcinoma. Nodal metastasis present. Margins uninvolved.
